module: Yaw control component for electronically locking all-wheel-drive transmissions (type "auxiliary", defaultOrder 70). It registers with tractionControl (order 10, but does nothing there) and yawControl (order 20). Under acceleration, if it detects oversteer via the body slip angle, it sets overrideMin/overrideMax of the locking actuator (by default "electronicSplitShaftLock") to distribute torque between the front/rear axles according to the mode (rearMain, frontMain, centerDiff).
notes: jbeam keys: awdActuatorName (default "electronicSplitShaftLock", name of a CMU actuator), controlMode ("rearMain" by default, "frontMain" or "centerDiff"; centerDiff reuses rearMain), slipAngleThreshold (default 0.2 rad).
If the actuator is not found, actAsTractionControl and actAsYawControl are replaced by nop and the component registers nowhere.
actAsYawControl always returns false on purpose, so that the ESC light does not turn on (too intrusive for AWD control); the real state is in isActingAsYC.

rearMain mode: overrideMin rises from 0 to 1 as the corrected slip angle goes from 0 to slipAngleThreshold; frontMain mode: overrideMax falls from 1 to 0. Understeer detection is not implemented ("todo" comment in the code).
Parameters modifiable via setParameters: tractionControl, tractionControl.isEnabled, yawControl, yawControl.isEnabled, yawControl.slipAngleThreshold, controlMode.
The control only acts if electrics.values.throttle > 0.

isActingAsYC.desc: True when a locking override is applied.

initSecondStage.desc: Looks for the AWD actuator, registers with the supervisors and reads controlMode and slipAngleThreshold.

updateGFX.desc: Empty (debug version: sends a state packet).

actAsTractionControl.desc: Called by tractionControl; does nothing and returns false.

actAsYawControl.desc: Called by yawControl: resets then computes the overrideMin/overrideMax bounds of the locking actuator from the body slip angle (oversteer under acceleration only).

registerCMU.desc: Stores the reference to the CMU.

setParameters.desc: Applies parameters (see notes) and recomputes the control method according to controlMode.

getConfig.desc: Returns a copy of the configuration.

sendConfigData.desc: Sends the configuration to the CMU (debug packet).
